title: Laptop not charging
symptom: Laptop battery level is not going up while plugged in
user_description: My laptop says plugged in but the battery percentage isn't going up. I'm leaving for a client meeting in an hour.

options.why: Possible later, but premature. First check the charger and socket, which are far more common causes.
Unrelated to charging in most cases and very destructive. Not a first step.

options.text: Check the charger is fully plugged into both the laptop and the wall, try another socket, and inspect the cable and charger light
options.why: Loose connections, a dead socket or a damaged cable are the most common causes. Always check the physical connections first.

options.text: Tell the user to leave it and hope it charges eventually
options.why: Does nothing to find the cause and may leave the user without a laptop for their meeting.

hints: How does the laptop get power from the wall?
Could the socket itself be the problem?
real_world_tip: If you have a spare charger of the same model, swap it in. It quickly shows whether the charger or the laptop is at fault.
